newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Germany's Kohl arrives for Indonesia visit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kohl arrives for Indonesia visit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl arrived in Jakarta on Saturday for an official visit to Indonesia.
His German air force jet touched down at Jakarta's Halim Perdanakusuma military-civilian airport at 4:35 p.m. (1335 GMT).
Kohl, casually dressed, was met when he descended from the plane by Indonesia's Foreign Minister Ali Alatas and Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie.
The chancellor immediately boarded a helicopter under an overcast sky to be flown on a leisurely visit to Indonesia's Thousand Islands holiday area in the Java Sea north of Jakarta.
He was staying the night at a private resort there and spending Sunday with Indonesia's President Suharto and Habibie, including possibly a fishing trip.

The official part of Kohl's visit will take place on Monday, with talks primarily focused on trade and economic relations. A German official said last week the issue of human rights was also likely to be raised.
Kohl will leave for the Philippines on Tuesday and then go on to Japan.
